title: Replace high-order fitting by an exactly affine boundary response
statement: For a semi-infinite uniform harmonic chain with onsite b and hop t, D(E)=[1-v^2/(2t^2)]E+v^2*b/(2t^2)-H. Thus selected S=-1 on any open passband interval iff v^2=2t^2,H=b. Gapless b=1,t=1/2 gives semicircle density sqrt(E(2-E))/pi; exact gapless all-band matching has zero local Schur margin without instability.

body: The boundary Weyl function has affine real part in the propagation band; matching the slope and intercept is necessary and sufficient. The enhanced boundary hop is the folded even sector of a uniform infinite lattice, an established antecedent. The phase is relative to the declared free boundary frame, not a laboratory dispersion-free pulse. A gapped signal b=6/5 can have positive local margin, but needs a separate genuine soft channel for gapless dissociation infima.
